name: Murphy Flowage Campground
note: Rusk County Parks campground in the Rusk County Forest beside the 172-acre Murphy Flowage on Hemlock Creek, off County F about 13 mi north of Weyerhaeuser: one loop with a boat launch and dock, and a log picnic shelter across the road. One electric pedestal serves two sites and may need an extension cord. Site 9 is a walk-in tent site; the Ice Age Trail runs nearby. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Rusk County Parks reservation site (Konect, read 2026-11-17): campground list 'MURPHY CAMPGROUND ... 8 Campsites N7905 County F Birchwood, WI 54817'; Murphy page ('sites 1-8 have both 20-amp and 30-amp electricity'; 'Sites 3-6 have a water hookup'; 'Site 9 is Walk-in only'); per-site pages SITE #1-#8 'RV Pad 34' X 14'' (site 3) to 'RV Pad 67' X 14'' (sites 2, 7) with Book Now buttons; county campground map (back-in spurs off one loop, restrooms, well house, parking, boat landing); 8 site photos (June 2020, gravel/grass pads) -> current reservable county drive-in RV campground, every drive-in site fits a 23-ft rig. County forestry page 'CAMPING IN RUSK COUNTY PARKS ARE OPEN YEAR ROUND! Campsites - $30'. Rules PDF: ATV/UTVs prohibited in Murphy Campground; 'No horses'. Google Maps 'Murphy Flowage Campground' 4.7/6 pinned at the entrance (45.5754,-91.5118). Public (local): no price gate. Duplicate check 2026-11-17: no WI 'Murphy' entry; nothing within 6.9 km (nearest 3593 Audie Lake 6.95 km, 15705 Perch Lake 7.1 km, separate county campgrounds).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-17: Rusk County campground map (parks/i/lm/murphy_flowage_campground_map.jpg) puts the loop north of Murphy Flowage with the parking lot and boat landing between it and the water, and spurs 1 and 2 heading toward the flowage's east bay. Esri World Imagery (2600 m, 700 m, 320 m, 260 m and 220 m frames centred 45.5723,-91.4956 / 45.5740,-91.5070 / 45.5755,-91.5110 / 45.5757,-91.5085 / 45.5757,-91.5098, all rendered): the loop is an open clearing whose south and east sides are a continuous block of forest ~40-70 m deep before the shore; sites 1 and 2 sit inside that canopy, their spur ends ~35-45 m from the water through trees; sites 3-8 are on the north side of the loop, ~70 m+ from the water behind the loop road and woods; the only open ground to the water is the parking lot and boat landing (day use). No pad on open ground to the shore -> not lakefront. Official per-site photos (parks/i/ii/l__m1.jpg ... l__m8.jpg, June 2020, leaf-on) show woods and grass only, no water from any site -> no filtered view to support lakeview; default down. Flowage dammed at its west end by County F; campground DEM 394 m vs water ~382 m, beside the pool upstream of the outlet, so no below-dam issue. 172-acre flowage (county page) = a lake, not a pond. --Claude

sites.note: 8 back-in drive-in sites with 30/20-amp electric; sites 3-6 also have water. Posted pads run 34-67 ft by 14 ft. Site 9 is walk-in only (not counted).

facilities.note: Water is off from about the second week of October to late April. Nearest dump: the Cenex in Weyerhaeuser or Rice Lake.

Please utilize the Cenex gas station in Weyerhauser or Rice Lake.') + https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/alerts/635545b66fbe/ ('Water will be turned back on late April'), read 2026-11-17; the map shows 'Restrooms' without saying flush or vault (left absent)

season.note: Open year-round; water off in winter and sites are not plowed.

fees.note: Rusk County Parks: $30 a night at every county campground. Each RV or camping unit on a site pays the fee; the 6-person cap does not apply when all campers are family.

fees_source: https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/ ('CAMPING FEES $30.00 per night.') + https://ruskcounty.org/forestry ('Campsites - $30') + https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/i/lr/murphy_campground_rules_and_regulations.pdf ('Each RV or camping unit occupying a campsite must pay the required fee.'; 'A maximum of 6 persons per site. The only exception to this rule is if all campers are family members.'), read 2026-11-17

booking.note: Rusk County's own reservation site (Konect Parks), or the forestry office by phone. Reservations close 7 days before arrival; any site not reserved is first-come for that date. Only the current calendar year can be booked; next year's dates open January 1. Paid in full when booked, no refunds.

booking_source: https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/camping/murphy_campground/ ('All campsites reservations must be made seven or more days in advance otherwise they are first come'; 'There are no reimbursements for cancellations.') + https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/ ('Reservations are only available for the current calendar year.
